hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
I entreat Thee, O Master, to bear with me in my barrenness. Do not cut me down with a death stroke as though I were a tree without fruit, banishing me to the fire, but relent and make me fruitful, O Lover of mankind, and give me time to repent that I may wash away my many sins with tears,
Christ my Saviour.
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: О Forerunner, who didst live a blameless life in the desert, restore thou my mind, which hath become barren through sins.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: We glorify thee, О prophet, understanding thee to be the swallow heralding the divine spring to those in the world.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: О divine Forerunner, intercessor for my life, protector of my soul: Deliver me, thy servant, from the false accusation of man.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: O Lady, to the right tranquil haven of salvation guide me who am tempesttossed amid the tumult of slothfulness.

theotokion.text:
O Blessed Virgin Mary, calm the storm of my laziness, the tempest of indifference which endangers my boat on its way to salvation. Guide me, O Mother of God,
to the still waters in the harbor of repentance.

prokeimenon.refrain: The Lord will hearken unto me * when I cry unto Him.
prokeimenon.verse: When I called upon Thee, O God of my righteousness, Thou didst

hymns.text:
Like the prodigal I come and fall before Thee, O Lord; accept me as one of Thy hired servants,
and have mercy on me, O compassionate One!

As the man who fell among thieves and was wounded, I have fallen, and my soul is bruised by my many sins. To whom can I, the guilty one, run, if not to Thee, the only merciful Physician of our souls?
Pour out Thy great mercy on me, O God!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
O Holy martyrs, who fought the good fight and have received thy crowns, entreat the Lord
that He will have mercy on our souls.
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
Rejoice, O Lady, cloud of the reasonable and ineffable sun; Rejoice, lamp filled with light! Rejoice, golden candlestick, for Eve has been delivered from the curse by thee! Since thou hast boldness before thy Son and our God, O most pure one, never cease to plead with Him with thy maternal prayers,
for He will hear thee.

theotokion.text:
Rejoice, O Lady, cloud of the reasonable and ineffable sun; Rejoice, lamp filled with light! Rejoice, golden candlestick, for Eve has been delivered from the curse by thee! Since thou hast boldness before thy Son and our God, O most pure one, never cease to plead with Him with thy maternal prayers,
for He will hear thee.

dismissalTheotokion.text: O Theotokos, we greet thee, for thou wert manifested as higher than the angels,//when thou carried God in thy womb!

stichera.text: Cut me not down, a sinner, like the barren fig-tree, О Savior, but grant that I may tarry for many years, watering my soul with tears of repentance, that I may bring thee the fruit of almsgiving.
As Thou art the Sun of righteousness, enlighten the hearts of those who sing unto Thee: Glory to Thee, О Lord
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: Celebrating the memorial of Thy holy spiritual athletes, we chant unto Thee: Glory to Thee, О Lord!
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: Through the prayers of the Theotokos, * grant peace to the life of us who cry unto Thee: ** O merciful Lord, glory be to Thee!

hymns.text:
In days of old, I was banished by a tree from Paradise, and now that Thou hast been crucified, O Christ,
a tree has led me back there.
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
O What a fearful wonder! the Creator, standing before the creature, is condemned and crucified,
for the salvation of mankind!
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
O Cross of Christ, thou art the wonder of the holy angels, the mighty wound of demons and evil spirits,
and thou savest thy servants!
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: Beholding her Lamb stretched out upon the Tree, the Virgin, the unblemished ewe-lamb, cried aloud: “Woe is me, О my most sweet Child! What is this strange and most glorious mystery? How hath the iniquitous assembly lifted Thee up upon a Cross, and given Thee gall to drink, Who fed me with manna?”
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: When Thy Virgin Mother beheld Thee nailed by the Jews to the Cross on Golgotha, condemned by an unrighteous verdict, О my Christ, she cried out: “Woe is me, О my most beloved Son! What is this strange sight? How can the senseless children of the Jews nail Thee, the Lord of all, to the Cross?”
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: О all-holy Lady, we have all come to know thee alone as her who was manifest as a virgin even after giving birth. And when thou beheldest Him to Whom thou hast given birth, with His hands willingly nailed to the Tree, thou didst cry out: “O Longsuffering One, Thou dost willingly die, delivering all who hymn Thee from death!”
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: О all-holy Virgin Lady, who hast given birth unto the Lord Who in His tender compassion was nailed to the Cross, pouring forth a stream of life upon the world: Entreat Him, that our souls may be saved; for thee alone do we the faithful have as a refuge, bulwark and aid. Wherefore, we flee to thy protection.

theotokion.text:
O Holy Theotokos, who gave birth to the Master who was crucified for us, thou art our defender and our sure hope. As thou art an intercessor for us in our sinfulness,
we beseech thee to pray to Him to save our souls.

prokeimenon.refrain: Thy mercy, O Lord, shall pursue me * all the days of my life.
prokeimenon.verse: The Lord is my shepherd, and I shall not want. In a place of green

hymns.text:
Now that we have Thy cross as our hope, O Lord, we are no longer held back from the tree of life.
Glory to Thee, O Lord!

Hung upon the tree, O immortal Lord, Thou triumphed over the snares of the devil.
Glory to Thee, O Lord!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
Despising earthly things, O holy martyrs, and bravely preaching Christ in the arena, thou received from Him the due reward for thy sufferings. Since thou hast boldness before the presence of the almighty God,
we entreat thee to pray to Him for the salvation of our souls!
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
In those days, beholding thy Son upon the tree, thy heart, O most pure Virgin,
was pierced by the sword of grief.

theotokion.text:
In those days, beholding thy Son upon the tree, thy heart, O most pure Virgin,
was pierced by the sword of grief.

dismissalTheotokion.text: O Virgin Theotokos, intercede without ceasing to Christ God Who was crucified for us and destroyed the power of death//that He may save our souls!

stichera.text: Cut me not down, a sinner, like the barren fig-tree, О Savior, but grant that I may tarry for many years, watering my soul with tears of repentance, that I may bring thee the fruit of almsgiving.
As Thou art the Sun of righteousness, enlighten the hearts of those who sing unto Thee: Glory be to Thee, О Lord!
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: Rejoicing amid the tribunal of the violators of the law, Thy passion-bearers cried aloud: Glory be to Thee, О Lord!
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: From the Virgin Thou didst spring forth as light, О Christ, illumining the race of mankind. Glory be to Thee, О Lord!

hymns.text:
O Glorious apostles, thou plowed the whole earth with the plow of the understanding of God
making a great harvest of the faithful to grow!
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
O Blessed apostles, disperse the storm of my passions,
and enlighten me with the radiance of pure light!
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
As disciples of the Word, thou led the assembly of nations
from ignorance to the understanding of God.
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: As of old thou didst By thy prayers deliver the officers who were to be executed, О father Nicholas, so do thou now save us.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: О holy and most blessed hierarch Nicholas, deliver from griefs all who invoke and hymn thee with faith and love.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: Free thy servants from famine and pestilence, from earthquake and tribulations, and from all want, О most wise and holy hierarch Nicholas.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: Convey the entreaty of thy servants to thy Son, О most pure one, that He may save all whom He hath created.

theotokion.text:
O Blessed Virgin Mary, we beseech thee to pray to thy Son and our God
that He may have mercy on our souls.

prokeimenon.refrain: O God, in Thy name save me, * and in Thy strength do
prokeimenon.verse: O God, hearken unto my prayer, give ear unto the words of my

hymns.text:
O Glorious apostles, pillars of the Church and preachers of the truth, thou art brightly shining lamps, consuming every delusion with the fire of the spirit, and enlightening all mankind with faith! Therefore, we beseech thee, entreat our Saviour and God
that He may grant peace to the world, and salvation to our souls!

O Apostles of Christ, and fellow workers of the Saviour, thou took up thy crosses upon thy shoulders like plows, and cleansing the desolate land of the error of idolatry, thou sowed the word of faith.
We rightly honor thee, O holy apostles of Christ!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
O Martyrs, worthy of all praise: sheep of Christ's spiritual flock, thou art a living offering and acceptable sacrifice, pleasing to the O Lord! Though the earth did not cover thee, heaven received thee! Now that thou art companions with the angels, we entreat thee to pray with them to God our Saviour,
that He may grant peace to the world, and salvation to our souls!
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
We sing the praises of the only woman who remained Virgin after giving birth, for she is the Mother of God,
and we cry out to her: Glory to thee!

theotokion.text:
We sing the praises of the only woman who remained Virgin after giving birth, for she is the Mother of God,
and we cry out to her: Glory to thee!

dismissalTheotokion.text: The Fruit of thy womb, O pure one, is the perfect fulfillment of the law and of the prophets! Therefore, O Theotokos, we glorify thee with thanks//and exalt thee with great devotion!

stichera.text: О Master Who lovest mankind, Who art the Bestower of life, by Thy Cross Thou didst redeem the whole world. О Lord, glory be to Thee!

The Vine of life was nailed to the Cross, and the nations embraced paradise with the thief. This is the glory of the Church! These are the riches of the kingdom! О Lord Who suffered for our sake, glory be to Thee!
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: The all-praised passion-bearers of Christ were shown to be beacons for the world, crying aloud: Glory be to Thee, О Lord!
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: When the all-immaculate one beheld Thee willingly nailed to the Tree, weeping, she hymned Thy might.

hymns.text:
In order to bring mankind to perfection and make him divine, Thou, O only good One, became mortal and were crucified.
Glory to Thy power, O Christ!
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
When the assembly of the Jews condemned Thee to the Cross, O Word,
the earth quaked and the sun was darkened.
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
The wicked assembly crowned Thee with thorns, immortal One,
and Thou, O holy King, destroyed to the root the thorn tree of error!
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: Beholding her Lamb stretched out upon the Tree, the Virgin, the unblemished ewe-lamb, cried aloud: “Woe is me, О my most sweet Child! What is this strange and most glorious mystery? How hath the iniquitous assembly lifted Thee up upon a Cross, and given Thee gall to drink, Who fed me with manna?”
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: When Thy Virgin Mother beheld Thee nailed by the Jews to the Cross on Golgotha, condemned by an unrighteous verdict, О my Christ, she cried out: “Woe is me, О my most beloved Son! What is this strange sight? How can the senseless children of the Jews nail Thee, the Lord of all, to the Cross?”
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: О all-holy Lady, we have all come to know thee alone as the one who wast revealed to be a virgin after giving birth. And when thou didst behold Him to Whom thou hast given birth, with His hands willingly nailed to the Tree, thou didst cry out: “O Longsuffering One, Thou dost willingly die, delivering all who hymn Thee from death!”
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: О all-holy Virgin Lady, who hast given birth unto the Lord Who in His loving-kindness was nailed to the Cross, pouring forth a stream of life upon the world: Entreat Him, that our souls may be saved; for thee alone do we, the faithful have as a refuge, bulwark and aid. Wherefore, we flee to thy protection.

theotokion.text:
O Holy Theotokos, thou gavest birth to the Master Who was crucified for us; thou art our defender and our sure hope. As thou art the intercessor for us in our sinfulness,
we beseech thee to pray to Him to save our souls.

prokeimenon.refrain: My help cometh from the Lord, * Who hath made heaven
prokeimenon.verse: I have lifted up mine eyes to the Mountains, from whence cometh

hymns.text:
Now that we have Thy Cross as our hope, O Lord, we are no longer held back from the tree of life.
Glory to Thee, O Lord!

Hung upon the tree, O immortal Lord, Thou triumphed over the snares of the devil.
Glory to Thee, O Lord!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
Glory to Thee, O Christ God, the apostles' boast, the martyrs' joy,
whose preaching was the consubstantial Trinity!
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
When the all pure one beheld Thee, nailed of Thine own will to the Cross,
she wept and praised Thy might!

theotokion.text:
When the all pure one beheld Thee, nailed of Thine own will to the Cross,
she wept and praised Thy might!

dismissalTheotokion.text: O Virgin Theotokos, intercede without ceasing to Christ God Who was crucified for us and destroyed the power of death//that He may save our souls!

stichera.text: О glorious apostles, pillars of the Church, preachers of the Truth, radiant beacons: With the fire of the Spirit ye consumed all delusion and illumined the race of mankind with faith. Wherefore, we beseech you: Entreat our Savior and God, that He grant peace to the world and save our souls.

О apostles of Christ, husbandmen of the Savior, bearing the Cross upon your shoulders as a plough, and having cleared the earth made hard by the delusion of idolatry, ye sowed the word of faith, and are therefore fittingly honored, О holy apostles of Christ.
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: Breathing forth one thing only, and looking toward one thing alone, the passion-bearing martyrs, having found the one path of life, which is death for Christ, urged one another on to death. О the wonder! For, snatching up the treasures of torment, they said to each other: If we die not now, we shall die in any case; wherefore, let us do things worthy of life: let us do what needs be done with love of honor, that we may sell what we have and purchase life with death!” By their prayers, О God, have mercy on us.
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: Thou wast ineffably born from the Virgin, О Christ, enlightening those in darkness, who cry aloud: Glory be to Thee, О Lord!

hymns.text:
O Saviour, when Thou come to judge all the world, put me not to shame,
though I have done shameful deeds.
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
Glory to Thee, O Christ God, the apostles' boast, the martyrs' joy,
whose preaching was the consubstantial Trinity!
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
O Holy martyrs, who fought the good fight and have received thy crowns, entreat the Lord
that He will have mercy on our souls.
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: О Savior, when Thou comest to judge the whole world put me not to shame, for I have committed shameful acts.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: Glory be to Thee, O Christ God, Thou boast of the apostles, joy of the martyrs; whose preaching was of the consubstantial Trinity.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: O holy martyrs, ye who have fought the good fight and received your crowns, pray to the Lord, that our souls be saved.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: Thou hast been known to have become a mother * in a manner surpassing nature O Theotokos, * and hast remained a virgin in a manner beyond all telling and understanding; * no tongue can expound the wonder of thy birthgiving. * For while thy conceiving O pure one, was most glorious, * the manner of thy birthgiving transcends comprehension; * for where God so willeth, the order of nature is overthrown. * Wherefore, we all, knowing thee to be the Mother of God, * do earnestly entreat thee: ** Pray thou that our souls be saved!

theotokion.text:
No tongue can speak of thy wonderful childbearing for the order of nature was overruled by God! Thou wert revealed to be a Mother above nature, for thou remained a Virgin beyond reason and understanding! Thy conception was most glorious, O Theotokos! The manner of thy giving birth was ineffable, O Virgin! Knowing thee to be the Mother of God, devoutly we pray to thee:
Beseech Him to save our souls!

prokeimenon.refrain: O God, my helper art Thou, * and Thy mercy shall go
prokeimenon.verse: Rescue me from mine enemies, O God, and from them that rise up

hymns.text:
Despising earthly things, O holy martyrs, and bravely preaching Christ in the arena, thou received from him the due reward for thy sufferings. Since thou hast boldness before the presence of the almighty God,
we entreat thee to pray to Him for the salvation of our souls!

O Martyrs, worthy of all praise: Sheep of Christ's spiritual flock, thou art a living offering and acceptable sacrifice, pleasing to the Lord! Though the earth did not cover thee, heaven received thee! Now that thou art companions with the angels, we entreat thee to pray with them to God our Saviour,
that He may grant peace to the world, and salvation to our souls!
hymns.verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen * and taken to Thyself, О Lord.

hymns.text: In the beginning, Thou formed man according to Thine image and likeness, placing him in paradise as ruler over Thy creation. But he was deceived through the envy of the devil; he ate the fruit and transgressed Thy commands. Therefore, O Lord, Thou condemned him to return to the earth from which he was taken, and to ask for rest.
hymns.verse: Their souls * shall dwell among good things.

hymns.text: О our Savior, grant rest to our brethren whom Thou hast removed from transitory things, and who cry: Glory be to Thee, О Lord.

glory.text:
As the only one who encompassed the boundless One, and gave birth to the incarnate Word of God,
entreat Him that our souls may be saved!

theotokion.text:
As the only one who encompassed the boundless One, and gave birth to the incarnate Word of God,
entreat Him that our souls may be saved!

stichera.text: О Master Who lovest mankind, Who art the Bestower of life, by Thy Cross Thou didst redeem the whole world. О Lord, glory be to Thee!

The Vine of life was nailed to the Cross, and the nations embraced paradise with the thief. This is the glory of the Church! These are the riches of the kingdom! О Lord Who suffered for our sake, glory be to Thee!
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: Celebrating the memorial of Thy holy passion-bearers, О Christ, we hymn Thee, crying aloud: Glory be to Thee, О Lord!
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: When thou didst behold thine own Son upon the Tree of old, О most pure one, thy heart was wounded by the sword of grief.

dogmatikon.label: Theotokion — Dogmatikon
dogmatikon.text:
The King of heaven, because of His love for man,
appeared on earth and dwelt with men.
He took flesh from the pure Virgin
and after assuming it, He came forth from her.
The Son is one: in two natures, yet one Person.
Proclaiming Him as perfect God and perfect Man,
we confess Christ our God!
Entreat Him, O unwedded Mother, to have mercy on our souls.

resurrectional.note: Resurrectional stichera from OCA Obikhod (TT). Used at Saturday Great Vespers, Lord I Have Cried, verses 6–1.

hymns.text:
We offer to Thee, O Christ, our evening song and reasonable service, for Thou didst will to have mercy on us
by Thy Resurrection.

Lord, Lord, do not cast us away from Thy face! For Thou didst will to have mercy on us
by Thy Resurrection.

Rejoice, O holy Zion: Mother of the churches, the abode of God, for thou wast the first to receive remission of sins
by the Resurrection.

The Word of God the Father, begotten before the ages, in the latter times willed to be incarnate of the Virgin and endured crucifixion unto death. He has saved mortal man
by His Resurrection.

We glorify Thee, O Lord, for Thou didst voluntarily endure the Cross for our sake. We fall down in worship before Thee, O almighty Savior. Do not cast us away from Thy face but hear us and save us, O Lover of man,
by Thy Resurrection!

Glory to Thee, O Savior Christ, Only-begotten Son of God, who wast nailed to the Cross
and resurrected from the tomb on the third day!

glory.label: Resurrectional Doxastichon
glory.text:
We glorify Thy Resurrection from the dead, O Christ, by which Thou hast freed Adam's race from the tortures of hell,
and as God hast granted to the world eternal life and great mercy.
glory._alsoNumberedNote: Unlike most tones' doxastika (which are framed for the Glory slot, e.g. Tone 3 'we offer our evening song'), this text reads as a plain resurrectional sticheron. When the Menaion claims the Glory it is sung as the 7th numbered sticheron, filling the slot the OCA Obikhod otherwise leaves short. Verified against the St. John of Damascus (Tyler) choir booklet for 2026-08-02, which numbers the Octoechos block 10-4 and ends on this text. Do NOT set this on a tone without the same verification.

hymns.label: Idiomelon
hymns.text:
Descending from heaven to ascend the Cross, the eternal Life has come for death to raise those who are fallen; to enlighten those in darkness.
O Jesus, our Savior and Illuminator, glory to Thee!

hymns.label: Sticheron 2
hymns.text:
We glorify Christ, Who rose from the dead. He accepted the human body and soul, and freed both from suffering. His most pure soul descended to hell, which He spoiled. His holy body did not see corruption in the tomb.
He is the Redeemer of our souls.

hymns.label: Sticheron 3
hymns.text:
In psalms and songs we glorify Thy Resurrection from the dead, O Christ. By it, Thou hast freed us from the tortures of hell
and as God hast granted eternal life and great mercy.

hymns.label: Sticheron 4
hymns.text:
O Master of all, incomprehensible Creator of heaven and earth, by Thy suffering on the Cross Thou hast gained passionlessness for me. Accepting burial and arising in glory, Thou didst resurrect Adam with Thyself by Thine almighty hand. Glory to Thy rising on the third day! By it Thou hast granted us eternal life and cleansing of sins
as the only compassionate One.

theotokion.label: Aposticha Theotokion
theotokion.text:
O unwedded Virgin, who ineffably didst conceive God in the flesh, O Mother of God most high, accept the cries of thy servants, O blameless one! Grant cleansing of transgressions to all!
Receive our prayers and pray to save our souls!

troparion.label: Resurrectional Troparion
troparion.text:
Thou didst descend from on high, O Merciful One! Thou didst accept the three-day burial to free us from our sufferings!
O Lord, our Life and Resurrection, glory to Thee!

kontakion.label: Resurrectional Kontakion
kontakion.text: By rising from the tomb, Thou didst raise the dead and resurrect Adam. Eve exults in Thy Resurrection, and the world celebrates Thy rising from the dead, O greatly Merciful One!

dismissalTheotokion.label: Resurrectional Dismissal Theotokion
dismissalTheotokion.text: For our sake Thou wast born of the Virgin and didst endure crucifixion, O Good One, destroying death by death. Revealing the Resurrection as God, do not despise the work of Thy hand. Reveal Thy love for man, O Merciful One, and accept the Theotokos praying for us, and save the despairing people, O our Savior.

stichera.text: Dipping Thy fingers in Thy blood and staining them therewith as with red ink, Thou hast signed for us a royal reprieve, О Master; wherefore, we entreat Thee with faith: Among Thy firstborn number those who have departed unto Thee, the tenderly compassionate One, and grant that they may receive the joy of Thy righteous.

Having fulfilled Thy priestly ministry as a man, and been sacrificed as a lamb, Thou didst redeem mankind from corruption, offering Thyself as an oblation to the Father. As Thou art the Lover of mankind, do Thou enroll the departed in the land of the living, where torrents of delight pour forth, and well-springs of eternal life flow.
stichera.verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen * and taken to Thyself, O Lord.

stichera.text: O Thou Who, in the depths of Thine ineffable wisdom, dost set the bounds of life, and foresee things to come, cause the servants whom Thou hast taken to Thyself to dwell in the life to come. Settle them, by peaceful waters, in the splendor of the saints, О Lord, where the voice of joy and praise is heard.
stichera.verse: Their souls * shall dwell among good things.

stichera.text: О Word Who art invisible, of the same nature and form as the Father and the Spirit, for my sake Thou didst appear as a man in the flesh. In that Thou art merciful and lovest mankind, with the beauties of Thy majesty and comeliness enlighten those who have passed from this life, О Author of life.
stichera.verse: Their memorial * is from generation to generation.

glory.text: In that thou didst conceive the beginningless Word of God the Father, with thy maternal boldness earnestly entreat Him, О Theotokos, that He number thy servants where the jubilation of the righteous who rejoice and praise thee, is continuous, and where the radiance is eternal, and the voice of him who keepeth festival is sweet.

hymns.text:
O Lord, Thou came to call sinners, accepting the thief, the publican, and the prodigal: I have sinned against Thee more than these.
Call me to repentance, O Lover of mankind.
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
Thou turned tax collectors into pastors of the Church, and the one who persecuted her became her defender! By their prayers, O Saviour, make me one of Thy flock,
preserving me from being devoured by strange and evil passions.
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
Weep, O my sinful soul; turn to God before the end! Call to him from thy heart, and cry out, O evil-doer: I have sinned before Thee, O Christ. Do not despise me, I pray, but accept me again,
for Thou art merciful and grant forgiveness.
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: О Lord, the councils of the incorporeal beings unceasingly glorify Thee, delighting in Thy beauty and ineffable comeliness, richly illumined by the light of the threefold Sun. By their prayers and intercession, О Savior, save Thou our souls.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: О Lord, by Thine omnipotent word and Thy most holy Spirit Thou didst arrange the harmonious choirs of the angels, imparting effulgence to them with never-waning rays. By their prayers and intercession, О Savior, save Thou our souls.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: О Lord, the seraphim hymn Thee, and the authorities, angels, and principalities, the dominions, thrones and powers, the archangels and the dread cherubim offer Thee praise. By their prayers and intercession, О Savior, save Thou our souls.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: I, a created being, ever offend the Creator and move Him to anger. Grant me correction, О maiden, first conciliating Him; and with thy help raise me up to pleasing works, that I may receive salvation and remission.

theotokion.text:
Creation ever offends and bears the curse of the Creator. Pray, O maiden, that I may avoid that fate. Through thy help we accomplish noble deeds,
as we desire forgiveness and salvation.

prokeimenon.refrain: Behold now, bless ye the Lord, * all ye servants of the Lord.
prokeimenon.verse: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of

hymns.text:
The angels never cease singing praises to Thee, and I fall before Thee, O King and Master! I cry out like the publican:
Be merciful to me, O God, and save me!
Since thou are immortal, O my soul, do not be overwhelmed by the waves of life. Come to thy senses and cry out to the Benefactor: Be merciful to me, O God, and save me!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
O Martyrs of the Lord, thou sanctify every place and heal every ill. Now therefore, intercede with Him,
that He may deliver our souls from every wile and snare of the enemy!
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
The voice of the archangel proclaimed: Rejoice, Mother of God, for thou will give birth to Christ,
the One Who gives life to the world!

theotokion.text:
The voice of the archangel proclaimed: Rejoice, Mother of God, for thou will give birth to Christ,
the One Who gives life to the world!

dismissalTheotokion.text: Rejoice, for thou accepted from the angel the joy of the world! Rejoice, for thou hast borne the Creator and Lord!//Rejoice, for thou wert deemed worthy to be the Mother of God!

beatitudes.note: Sunday resurrectional Beatitudes ("Blesseds") of Tone 8 — the dedicated Octoechos set, NOT the canon. 6 resurrectional troparia + Glory (Trinitarian) + Both-now (Theotokion). Flat list; the last two entries map to the Glory / Now slots. Sourced from saintjonah.org Octoechos Beatitude Verses.

troparia.label: Resurrection
troparia.text: Remember us, O Christ, Thou Savior of the world, as Thou didst remember the thief upon the Cross; and account us all worthy of Thy heavenly Kingdom, O Thou Who alone art compassionate.

troparia.label: Resurrection
troparia.text: Hearken, O Adam, and rejoice with Eve; for he who of old stripped thee and her naked, and by deception hath taken all of us captive, hath been set at nought by the Cross of Christ.

troparia.label: Resurrection
troparia.text: Nailed of Thine own will to the Tree, O our Savior, Thou didst deliver Adam from the curse which came through the tree, and hast rewarded that which is in Thine image with a dwelling in paradise, in that Thou art compassionate.

troparia.label: Resurrection
troparia.text: Today is Christ risen from the tomb, granting incorruption unto all the faithful; and He reneweth the joy of the myrrh-bearing women after His suffering and resurrection.

troparia.label: Resurrection
troparia.text: Rejoice, O wise myrrh-bearing women, who were first to behold the resurrection of Christ, and who proclaimed to the apostles the glad tidings of the restoration of the whole world!

troparia.label: Resurrection
troparia.text: O ye apostles, who are manifestly the friends of Christ and are to be enthroned with Him in glory: entreat Him with boldness, that He intercede for us, for ye are His disciples.

troparia.label: Glory
troparia.text: O unoriginate Trinity, indivisible Essence, Unity equally enthroned, equal in honor and glory, transcendent Nature and Kingship: Save us who praise Thee with faith!

troparia.label: Theotokion
troparia.text: Rejoice, spacious habitation of God! Rejoice, ark of the new covenant! Rejoice, jar whence the heavenly Manna is given to all!

afterKathisma2.text:
Thou the Life of all, didst rise from the dead, and an Angel of light cried out to the women saying: “Cease your tears. Bring the good tidings unto the
Apostles.” Cry aloud in hymns that Christ the Lord hath arisen who as God was well-pleased to save mankind.

When Thou wast indeed risen from the tomb Thou didst command the holy women to announce the Resurrection to the Apostles, as it is written; and
Peter, having arrived quickly, stood by the grave and seeing the light in the tomb was affrightened. observing the grave clothes lying therein, without the divine body, and believing he cried aloud: “Glory be to Thee O Christ God our
Savior, Who hast saved us all, for Thou art the effulgence of the Father.”

afterKathisma2.label: Glory…, Now…, Theotokion
afterKathisma2.text: Let us hymn the heavenly gate and ark, the all-holy mountain, the cloud of light, the heavenly ladder, the spiritual Paradise, the redemption of Eve, the great treasure of the world; because salvation for the world and forgiveness of ancient offences were wrought in her. Therefore we cry unto her: Intercede with thine own Son and God to grant forgiveness offences to those who devoutly worship thy most holy Offspring.

afterKathisma3.text: Mortals have sealed Thy tomb, O Savior and an Angel hath rolled away the stone from the door. Women saw Thee risen from the dead, and announced the good tidings to Thy Disciples in Zion: “The life of all hath risen and the bonds of death are loosed. O Lord, glory be to Thee.”

The women having brought sweet-smelling burial spices heard an Angel’s voice coming from the tomb: “Cease thy tears, and bring joy instead of sorrow.” Wherefore Cry ye aloud in hymns that Christ the Lord is risen, who as God was well-pleased to save the race of mankind.

afterKathisma3.label: Glory…, Now…, Theotokion
afterKathisma3.text:
In Thee, O Full of grace, doth all creation rejoice, the ranks of Angels and the race of mankind; O all-hallowed Temple and spiritual Paradise, boast of
Virgins. For from thee God became incarnate and He who is our God before the ages became a child. He hath made thy womb a throne and rendered it wider than the heavens. In thee, O Full of grace, doth all creation rejoice; glory be to thee.

matins.hypakoe: The myrrh-bearing women standing at the tomb of the Giver of life seeking the immortal Master among the dead; and having received the glad tidings of joy from the Angel announced unto the Apostles that Christ the Lord is risen, granting the world great mercy.

troparia:
From my youth the enemy doth tempt me, enflaming me with the desire for pleasures; but placing my trust in Thee O Lord, I put him to flight.
Let those that hate Zion, become like grass before it is tilled; for Christ severeth their necks with the sharp blade of torments.
By the Holy Spirit all things have life; Light from Light, eminent God: we hymn Him together with the Father and the Word.

Let my humble heart be sheltered by the fear of Thee; lest it fall away from
Thee by being conceited, O exceedingly compassionate One.
He who hath his hope in the Lord will not be afraid when the Lord judgeth all things with fire and torment.

Everyone inspired by the Holy Spirit seeth and foretelleth all, working the greatest wonders, singing of one God in three Hypostases; for though the
Divinity radiates with triune light, it ruleth as one.

I have cried unto Thee, O Lord, hearken unto me, bend Thine ear to my supplications when I cry unto Thee, and do thou cleanse me before taking me from this life.
Each and every one who returneth to mother earth will depart to receive torments or rewards in reward for their life’s actions.

Contemplation of God by the Holy Spirit is of a thrice-holy unity; for the
Father is beginningless, from Whom the Son was begotten before time, and the Spirit equal in essence and majesty, doth blaze forth equally from the
Father.

Behold, what is so good, what is so pleasant as to see brothers dwelling together? For by this the Lord hath promised eternal life.
The One who adorneth the lilies of the field doth command us to be unconcerned over temporal things.
By the Holy Spirit, by one single cause all things gain the reward of peace; for He is God perfectly consubstantial with both the Father and the Son.

prokeimenon.refrain: The Lord shall be king unto eternity; thy God, O Zion, unto generation and generation.
prokeimenon.verse: Praise the Lord, O my soul. I will praise the Lord in my life.

matins.postGospelSticheron: Jesus having risen from the grave, as He foretold, hath given us life eternal, and great mercy.

laudsStichera.verse: To do among them the judgment that is written This glory shall be to all His saints.
laudsStichera.text:
O Lord, though Thou didst stand before the judgment seat being judged by
Pilate, yet Thou wast seated with the Father and was not absent from Thy throne. And risen from the dead Thou hast freed the world from slavery to the stranger, as Thou art full of compassionate pity and love for mankind.

laudsStichera.verse: Praise ye God in His saints, praise Him in the firmament of His power.
laudsStichera.text: O Lord, the Jews laid Thee as a corpse in a grave, and soldiers guarded Thee as a sleeping king sealing Thee with a seal as if a treasury of life; but Thou didst arise and grant incorruption to our souls.

laudsStichera.verse: Praise Him for His mighty acts, praise Him according to the multitude of His greatness.
laudsStichera.text: O Lord, Thou hast given us Thy Cross as a weapon against the devil; for he doth quake and tremble, unable to contemplate Thy power; for Thou didst raise the dead and abolish death: Wherefore we worship Thy Burial and Thy Rising.

laudsStichera.verse: Praise Him with the sound of trumpet, praise Him with the psaltery and harp.
laudsStichera.text: Thine Angel, O Lord, having proclaimed Thy Resurrection, filled the guards with fear, but he cried unto the women saying: “Why seek ye the living among the dead? Being God He is risen granting life to the whole world.”

laudsStichera.verse: Praise Him with timbrel and dance, praise him with strings and flute.
laudsStichera.text:
Thou didst endure the Cross, O Thou who art impassible in Thy Divinity, to free us from slavery to the enemy and Thou didst accept burial for three days, making us immortal, and granting life unto us through Thy Resurrection, O
Christ God, Lover of mankind.

laudsStichera.verse: Praise Him with tuneful cymbals, praise Him with cymbals of jubilation. Let every breath praise the Lord.
laudsStichera.text: O Christ, I worship, I glorify, and I praise Thy Resurrection from the tomb, through which Thou hast delivered us from the unbreakable bonds of Hades and as God hast granted the world eternal life and great mercy.

laudsStichera.verse: Arise, O Lord my God, let Thy hands be lifted high; forget not Thy paupers to the end.
laudsStichera.text: The Lawless men, watching over Thy grave which had received life, sealed it; but Thou, as the immortal and all-powerful God, arose on the third day.

laudsStichera.verse: I will confess Thee, O Lord, with my whole heart, I will tell of all Thy wonders.
laudsStichera.text: When Thou didst enter the gates of Hades, O Lord, and didst shatter them, the prisoners therein cried aloud: “Who is this?, for He hath not been condemned to the lowest parts of the earth, but hath torn down the prisons of death as if a tent, we received Him as One mortal, and we tremble before Him as God.” O All-powerful Savior have mercy on us.

canonIrmoi.1: The wonderworking staff of Moses, striking and dividing the sea in the figure of a cross, once drowned Pharaoh the pursuing charioteer, while it saved the fleeing people of Israel as they fled on foot, chanting a hymn unto God.
canonIrmoi.3:
O Christ fortify me on the rock of Thy commandments, Thou who in the beginning didst establish the heavens with understanding and didst establish the earth upon the waters, for there is none holy save
Thee, O only Lover of mankind.
canonIrmoi.4:
Thou, O Lord, art my strength and Thou art my power, Thou art my God and Thou art my joy, Thou Who, while never leaving the bosom of Thy Father, hast visited our poverty. Therefore with the Prophet
Habbakuk I cry unto Thee, ‘Glory to Thy power, O Lover of mankind!’
canonIrmoi.5: O Light never-waning, why hast Thou turned Thy face from me and why hath the alien darkness surrounded me, wretched though I be? But do Thou guide my steps I implore Thee and turn me back towards the light of Thy commandments.
canonIrmoi.6: Cleanse me, O Savior, for many are mine iniquities; lead me up from the abyss of evils I pray Thee, for unto Thee have I cried, and Thou hast hearkened unto me, O God of my salvation.
canonIrmoi.7:
Once in Babylon the fire stood in awe of God's condescension; for which sake the youths in the furnace, dancing with joyous steps as in a meadow, chanted: O God of our fathers,
Blessed art Thou!
canonIrmoi.8:
In his wrath the Chaldean Tyrant made the furnace blaze, with heat fanned sevenfold for the servants of God; but when he perceived that they had been saved by a greater power he cried aloud to the Creator and
Redeemer; ‘ye children bless, ye priests praise, ye people, supremely exalt Him throughout all ages’.
canonIrmoi.9: Heaven was stricken with awe, and the ends of the earth were filled with amazement, for God hath appeared in the flesh, and thy womb was rendered more spacious than the heavens. Wherefore, the ranks of men and of angels magnify thee as the Theotokos.

1.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
1.text: How can we not but marvel at Christ’s all-powerful divinity? To the faithful it poureth forth dispassion from his passion, while from His holy side, it sheddeth forth a fount of incorruption, and from His tomb, eternal life.

1.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
1.text: How glorious the Angel doth now appear to the Women, wearing the luminous attributes of natural immaterial purity; for by his countenance he revealeth the radiance of the Resurrection as he crieth aloud, “The Lord hath been raised!”

1.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
1.text: Glorious things have been spoken of thee in generation after generation, O Virgin Theotokos, who, while remaining pure, didst contain within thy womb God the Word. Wherefore, after God, we all honor thee as our protection.

1.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
1.text: The gates of the Hades of suffering have been destroyed, and its gatekeepers tremble in fear upon seeing in the lowest depths the One who on high supranaturally surpasseth the nature of all things.

1.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
1.text:
The ranks of Angels stood amazed when they saw mankind’s fallen nature, which had been held fast in the lowest depths, now seated upon the throne of the
Father.

1.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
1.text: O Mother without bridegroom, the ranks of Angels and of mortal mankind sing thy praise without ceasing, for thou didst carry their Creator as an infant in thine arms.

1.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
1.text: Immaculate Mother of God, who hast given birth beyond nature to the incarnate and eternal Word, we sing thy praises.

1.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
1.text: The Virgin hath given birth unto Thee, O Christ, the cluster of grapes from whence drippeth the life-bearing sweetness of the world’s salvation.

1.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
1.text: The race of Adam, having now been raised to blessedness beyond all telling, doth fittingly glorify thee, O Theotokos.

3.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
3.text: The salvific Passion of Thy flesh, O Christ, hath justified Adam, who had been condemned by the taste of sin; for Thou, who alone art without sin, hast revealed that Thou didst remain uncondemned by the trial of death.

3.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
3.text:
O Jesus my God, Thou hast made the light of the Resurrection to shine forth upon those that sit in the darkness and shadow of death, and by Thy divinity
Thou hast bound the strong one and scattered his spoils.

3.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
3.text:
Thou wast revealed to be higher than the Cherubim and
Seraphim, O Theotokos, for thou alone hast received within thy womb, O undefiled one, God who is uncircumscribable; and so with hymns we believers ever call thee blessed.

3.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
3.text: When of old I disobeyed Thy commandments, O Lord Who hath fashioned me, Thou didst reckon me a stranger; however having refashioned me and taught me obedience, Thou hast reconciled me to Thyself through the Crucifixion.

3.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
3.text: Having made thine abode within a Virgin, Thou O Lord, didst appear in the flesh to mankind, as befitted Thee to be seen. And Thou didst reveal her to be truly the Mother of God and the succor of believers, O only Lover of mankind.

3.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
3.text: Grant help unto me by thine intercessions, O all-pure one, by warding off the assaults of dreaded dangers.

3.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
3.text: When thou, O Theotokos, didst give birth to the prince of life on behalf of all the world, Thou didst become the restoration of our foremother Eve.

3.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
3.text: By thy power grant me life, O all-pure one, who hath truly given birth to God in the flesh, the hypostatic power of the Father.

4.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
4.text: While I was hostile towards Thee, Thou didst love me exceedingly, for by a wondrous self-emptying, Thou didst descend to earth, O compassionate Savior, not spurning the indignity of the coarseness of my state, yet remaining in the height of Thine ineffable glory, whereby Thou hast glorified me who had hitherto existed in dishonor.

4.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
4.text: Who now doth not stand in awe, O Master, upon seeing death destroyed through Thy suffering, corruption taking flight through Thy Cross, and Hades emptied of its wealth through Thy death? These actions result from Thy lofty power, O Thou Crucified Lover of mankind.

4.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
4.text: Thou art the boast of the faithful, O Mother unwedded, thou art the protection, thou art the refuge of Christians, their wall and safe harbor; for thou dost bring their supplications before thy Son, O all-immaculate One, and savest from dangers those who with faith and love acknowledge thee to be the pure Theotokos.

4.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
4.text:
The lawless and disobedient children nailed Thee to the Cross, O Lover of mankind, but in Thy compassion Thou hast, through it, saved those who glorify
Thy sufferings.

4.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
4.text:
By arising from the grave, Thou hast raised with Thee all the dead in Hades, and in Thy loving compassion Thou hast enlightened those who glorify Thy
Resurrection.

4.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
4.text: O Immaculate Mary, implore God whom thou didst bare to grant thy supplicants forgiveness of their offences.

4.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
4.text: O Theotokos, thou art the un-ploughed land that brought forth the ear of corn which granteth life unto the world, do thou save those who sing thy praises.

4.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
4.text:
All we who have been enlightened know thee, O all-pure one, to be the
Mother of God, for thou, O Ever-Virgin, didst bear the Sun of righteousness.

4.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
4.text:
Grant us the pardon of our offences, as thou alone art without sin, and grant peace unto thy world, O God, by the supplications of her who hath given birth to
Thee.

5.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
5.text:
O Savior, Thou didst endure being wrapped in a cloak as Thou wast mocked before Thy Passion, thus covering the unsightly nakedness of the first-formed
Adam, and being nailed to the Cross naked, Thou didst strip from Thyself, O
Christ, the tunic of death.

5.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
5.text: Rising out of the dust of death, O Christ, Thou hast refashioned my fallen nature and rendered it incorrupt, revealing it as once again a princely image, radiating with the light of incorruption.

5.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
5.text:
Having obtained a mother’s freedom of speech before thy Son,
O all-pure one, we beseech thee to neglect not thy maternal care for us, for thee alone do we Christians present to the Master as a compassionate means of atonement.

5.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
5.text: Guide us and grant us peace by the power of Thy Cross, O Christ, for by it we fall down before Thee, O Lover of mankind.

5.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
5.text: O our God, guide the lives of us who sing the praises of Thine arising, and grant us peace, O only Lover of mankind.

5.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
5.text: O Mary, most pure and revered, who knew not wedlock, implore thy Son and our God to send down upon us the faithful, His great mercy.

5.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
5.text:
Calm the stormy tempest of my passions, O thou who hast given birth to
God, my guide and my Lord.

5.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
5.text:
The ranks of Angels and the companies of mortals worship thine Offspring, O
Immaculate Theotokos.

5.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
5.text: O Mary Theotokos thou who without bridegroom hast brought to naught the expectations of our enemies, bring joy to those who hymn thy praises.

6.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
6.text: Through a tree the author of evil hath mightily overthrown me, but raised upon a Cross, O Christ, Thou didst more mightily cast him down, confounding him, whilst raising me the one who had fallen.

6.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
6.text:
When Thou didst shine forth from the grave, then didst Thou take pity on
Zion, and in Thy compassion didst renew it by Thy divine blood, and now O
Christ, Thou dost reign over it as King forever.

6.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
6.text:
May we be delivered from grievous faults by thine intercessions,
O pure Birthgiver of God, and may we receive the divine radiance of the Son of
God, who ineffably became incarnate from thee.

6.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
6.text:
Thou didst stretch forth Thy hands upon the Cross, thus healing the hand of
Adam the first-formed, which he so greedily stretched forth in Eden, and instead of the bitter tree, O Christ, Thou didst taste gall, and as all-powerful, Thou dost save those who glorify Thy sufferings.

6.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
6.text: The Redeemer tasted of the ancient sentence of death that He might abolish the palace of corruption, and when He had visited those in Hades, He saved, as one all-powerful, those who hymn the praises of His Resurrection.

6.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
6.text: Cease not to intercede for us, O Most holy Virgin Theotokos, support of the faithful, for by our trust in thee we are made strong, therefore with love we glorify thee and Him who from thee ineffably assumed flesh.

6.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
6.text: O Theotokos, we the faithful proclaim thee to be the Temple and Ark, the living Bridal Chamber of God, and the gate of heaven.

6.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
6.text: Mary, bride of God, thine Offspring, Who hath become the destroyer of wooden idols, is worshipped together with the Father and the Spirit.

6.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
6.text: The Word of God revealed thee to mortal mankind to be a heavenly ladder, for through thee He descended to us.

7.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
7.text:
Thy glorious self-emptying, constituting the divine wealth of Thy poverty, O
Christ, amazed the Angels when they saw Thee nailed to the Cross, saving those who with faith cry aloud, “O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!”

7.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
7.text:
Upon Thy divine descent the regions beneath the earth were filled with light, and the darkness which previously pursued those therein, was driven out.
Therefore the prisoners from every age arose, crying aloud, “O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!”

7.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
7.text:
Trinitarian: Speaking of God with Orthodox belief, we proclaim Thee O Lord of all, to be Father of the one only-begotten Son, and we know only one right
Spirit Who proceedeth from Thee, consubstantial and co-eternal.

7.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
7.text: Thou hast wrought salvation in the midst of the inhabited world, O God, as the Prophet said, for lifted up upon the Tree, Thou hast called back all those who cry out to Thee with faith, “O God of our fathers, Blessed art Thou!”

7.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
7.text:
Rising from the tomb as from sleep, O compassionate Lord, Thou hast raised the world with Thee, while creation, through the Apostles’ preaching of Thine
Arising, hath been persuaded to cry to Thee. “Blessed are Thou O God of our
Fathers!”

7.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
7.text:
Equal in action, and equal in power and co-eternal with His
Begetter, the Word is fashioned in the womb of the Virgin by the good pleasure of the Father through the activity of the Spirit. “Blessed are Thou O God of our
Fathers!”

7.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
7.text: For our salvation Thou didst appear incarnate from a virginal womb, and knowing Thy Mother to be the one who gave birth to God, we cry with thanksgiving, “Blessed are Thou O God of our Fathers!”

7.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
7.text: O Virgin, thou art the most blessed rod from Jesse’s root, blossoming with a salvific fruit for those who with faith cry to thy Son, “Blessed are Thou O God of our Fathers!”

7.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
7.text:
O Hypostatic Wisdom of the Most High, through the Theotokos fill with wisdom and divine power all those who sing to Thee in faith, “Blessed are Thou
O God of our Fathers!”

8.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
8.text: In a manner befitting God, the supreme divine power of Jesus’ Divinity hath shone forth in our nature: for having tasted of death in the flesh upon the Cross for the sake of all, He hath abolished the strength of Hades. Without ceasing: O ye Youths bless, O ye priests praise, O ye people supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.

8.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
8.text: The Crucified One hath arisen, the boastful One hath fallen, the fallen and crushed have been set upright, corruption hath been banished and incorruption hath blossomed forth; for mortality hath been swallowed up by life. O ye Youths bless, O ye priests praise, O ye people supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.

8.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
8.text: Trinitarian: The Godhead of triune light, the single radiance shining forth from one three-hypostatic nature, the Begetter without beginning, the Word of the Father, one with him in Nature and Kingship, and the consubstantial Spirit; O ye Youths bless, O ye priests praise, O ye people supremely exalt Him throughout all ages.

8.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
8.text:
Unto the Lord who, stripped naked, hath stretched out His hands upon the
Tree for me, unto Him who doth call me and warm me with his noble nakedness, do all ye works of the Lord bless, and supremely exalt throughout the ages.

8.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
8.text: The Lord who hath raised me the fallen one, out of the lowest pits of Hades, and honored me with the high-throned glory of his Begetter, do all ye works of the Lord, bless, and supremely exalt throughout the ages.

8.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
8.text:
Thou didst appear as a daughter of fallen Adam, but also as the
Mother of the God who hath renewed my nature. Therefore all we His works sing
His praises as Lord and supremely exalt throughout the ages.

8.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
8.text: Do thou quench the seductive and fiery darts of those who are our enemies, that we may hymn thee, O pure Maiden, throughout the ages.

8.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
8.text:
In a manner surpassing nature, O Virgin, thou hast given birth to God the
Word, the Creator and Savior; therefore we hymn thee throughout the ages.

8.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
8.text: The unapproachable Light, Who made His abode within thee, O Virgin, hath shown thee to be a radiant golden lamp throughout the ages.

9.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
9.text:
Begotten simply in Thy divine nature which is without beginning, Thou didst become compound in nature by assuming flesh, giving it essence in Thyself, O
Word of God, and enduring the passion as a man, Thou didst remain beyond suffering as God, wherefore we magnify Thee in two natures inseparable and uncommingled.

9.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
9.text:
In accordance with Thy divine nature, O Most High, Thou didst address God as Thy Father when Thou didst descend to Thy servants and become man; and having risen from the dead Thou didst make Him who is by nature God and
Master, Father by grace, of those born of earth, wherefore we magnify Thee together with Him.

9.refrain: Glory to Thy holy Resurrection, O Lord.
9.text:
When thou didst give birth in the body in a manner surpassing nature to the good Word, Who came forth from the Father’s own essence before all ages, as He alone is Good, thou O Virgin was revealed as the Mother of God.
Him we now comprehend to be beyond the nature of flesh, even though He is clothed in a natural body.

9.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
9.text:
We know that Thou art the Son of God by nature, conceived in the womb of the Theotokos, and that Thou didst become man for our sake, and, as we behold
Thee hanging upon the Cross, we understand that Thou didst suffer in Thy human nature, yet as God Thou didst remain untouched by suffering.

9.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
9.text: Murky darkness hath been abolished, for from Hades Christ, the Sun of righteousness, hath dawned enlightening all the ends of the earth, radiant with the rays of his Divinity, man from heaven, God on earth, whom we magnify in two natures.

9.refrain: Glory to Thy precious Cross and Resurrection, O Lord.
9.text:
Bend Thy bow, prosper and reign, O Son of the Theotokos, subdue the people of Ishmael who war against us, and grant unto all Orthodox
Christians the Cross as an invincible weapon, and trophy of peace.

9.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
9.text: We are filled with joy and gladness at the thought of thee, overflowing with healing for those who approach thee and devoutly proclaim thee to be the Mother of God.

9.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
9.text: With psalms we sing thy praises, O thou who art Full of grace, and never silent, we ceaselessly offer thee our praises; for thou art a fount of rejoicing for all.

9.refrain: Most holy Theotokos, save us.
9.text: Fair is thy fruit, O Theotokos, for those who partake of it, it is incorruption, and for those who magnify thee with faith, it is life.

hymns.text: I do not have compunction, or a fountain of tears, or the gift of sincere confession. I do not have the weeping that purifies, or humility of heart. I have not emulated the publican, the harlot, or the prodigal son. how then shall I find remission of my many sins? But by the judgments Thou hast established, save me, O Christ.
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
I have estranged myself from every divine commandment, neglecting completely the better virtues. I have senselessly spent my whole life in laziness, and all my deeds have been unrighteous and evil.
Therefore have compassion on me, and save me, O merciful Christ.
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
O Good one, do not rebuke me in anger, even though I have torn myself away from Thee with my irrational mind, for I am the work of Thy hands. Thou made me in Thy likeness
in the depth of Thy compassion, O Lover of mankind!
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: О blessed Forerunner John, * with love ever return my lowly soul * to the Lord, * and by thy sacred mediations * quench for me the fire of pleasures, * guiding me to the fulfillment * of the precepts of God, * and truly cleansing the senses of my heart, ** that I may glorify thee.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: О all-praised Forerunner John, * thou offspring of a barren woman, * pure orchard of the Master * and adornment of mankind, * divine preserver of my lowly soul: * By thy prayers and aid * grant me readiness to forgive, * delivering me from the wiles of the serpent ** and his wicked treachery and attacks.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: Wholly delightful and full of divine bliss, * О ever-glorious one, * thou hast gladdened all * who come to thee with faith, * delighting the senses of our souls and bodies, * ever releasing us from infirmities * and tribulations, * from the assaults of evil, ** and soul-corrupting pleasures.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: With faith I hasten to thy protection, * О pure Birthgiver of God. * Save me from perils and misfortunes, * from the confusion of the passions and the malice of the demons. * For, possessed of an abyss of mercy, * thou hast been shown to be a mediatress of salvation, * О Lady who hast given birth to the only merciful, * all-compassionate and abundantly kind-hearted God.

theotokion.text:
We put all our trust in thee, O Theotokos. Protect us beneath thy veil and keep us from all evil afflictions. Save us and have mercy on us,
interceding for us before thy Son and our God.

prokeimenon.refrain: The Lord will hearken unto me * when I cry unto Him.
prokeimenon.verse: When I called upon Thee, O God of my righteousness, Thou didst

hymns.text:
The angels never cease singing praises to Thee, and I fall before Thee, O King and Master! I cry out like the publican:
Be merciful to me, O God, and save me!

Since thou art immortal, O my soul, do not be overwhelmed by the waves of life. Come to thy senses and cry out to the Benefactor:
Be merciful to me, O God, and save me!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
Entreat our God, O martyrs of the Lord, and beseech great bounties for our souls,
and purification of our many transgressions!
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
Rejoice, pride of the universe; Rejoice, temple of the Lord! Rejoice, over- shadowed mountain, Rejoice, refuge of all mankind! Rejoice, golden candlestick; Rejoice, precious glory of the Orthodox! rejoice, Mary, mother of Christ our God; Rejoice, tabernacle and paradise! Rejoice, table of divinity; Rejoice, O golden vessel!
Rejoice, for thou art the hope of all!

theotokion.text:
Rejoice, pride of the universe; Rejoice, temple of the Lord! Rejoice, over- shadowed mountain, Rejoice, refuge of all mankind! Rejoice, golden candlestick; Rejoice, precious glory of the Orthodox! rejoice, Mary, mother of Christ our God; Rejoice, tabernacle and paradise! Rejoice, table of divinity; Rejoice, O golden vessel!
Rejoice, for thou art the hope of all!

dismissalTheotokion.text: We the faithful magnify the Theotokos, the stable foundation of the faith and precious gift for our souls! Rejoice, for thou held in thy womb the Rock of life! Rejoice, hope of the world and protection of the afflicted!//Rejoice, O unwedded Bride!

stichera.text: When I bring to mind the multitude of the evils I have done, and come to consider the dread trial, seized with trembling I flee to Thee, the God Who is the Lover of mankind. Wherefore, disdain me not, I pray Thee, О only Sinless One; grant compunction to my lowly soul before the end, and save me.

Grant me tears as once Thou didst to the sinful woman, О God, and grant that I may wash the feet which have freed me from the path of deception, and that a pure life wrought for me by repentance I may offer Thee as myrrh of sweet savor, that even I may hear Thy longed- for voice saying: Thy faith hath saved thee. Go in peace!
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: What shall we call you, О saints? cherubim, for Christ rested on you. seraphim, for ye glorified Him without ceasing. angels, for ye rejected your bodies. Powers, for ye work miracles. Many are your names, and great your gifts. Pray ye that our souls be saved.
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: Those in heaven hymn thee, * O joyously blessed Mother unwedded, * and we glorify thine inscrutable birthgiving, O Theotokos; ** pray that our souls be saved!

hymns.text:
Thou were crucified upon the Cross, O Christ most good. Thy hands and feet were nailed; Thy holy side pierced with a spear, pouring out on me drops of divine salvation, blood and water to cleanse my sores and filth.
Glory to Thy goodness, O all compassionate Lord!
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
O Master, Thou bore suffering, to grant freedom from passion to those who venerate Thy passion. And Thou willingly endured in Thy forbearance going of Thine own will to the slaughter, and the spear, the nails, and the reed. Intercede then, O Lord, that I also on account of Thy passion
may obtain freedom from passion.
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
The undefiled maiden, beholding her Son raised of His own will upon the Cross, cried out, weeping and pricked to the heart: Woe is me, O my well- beloved Child! How has the thankless congregation of Jews repaid Thee, wishing to bereave me of Thee,
my Child Whom I so greatly love!
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: “I cannot bear to see Thee Who givest wakefulness to all, asleep upon the Tree, that Thou mightest give divine and saving watchfulness to those who have fallen into pernicious sleep through the fruit of disobedience!”, said the Virgin, whom we magnify, weeping.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: “The unrighteous council lifted Thee the Lamb Who taketh away the sins of the world up upon the Cross, and they pierced Thy side with a spear, and ran Thy hands and feet through with nails, О Long- suffering One. О the wicked savagery! О the audacity!”, cried the most pure one, weeping with compunction.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: “What is this thing that I now behold, О Master? Thou Who most wondrously holdeth all creation in the palm of Thy hand art suspended unjustly upon the Tree as a lamb, О Word of God, hung there by disobedient servants. О the patience! О Thy goodness, О Compassionate One!”, the most immaculate one said, weeping.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: When the most pure one beheld Thee led to the slaughter, * following Thee with tears she cried aloud: * Whither hast Thou gone, O my Son,? * I can no longer bear not beholding Thee ** O my abundantly merciful Jesus.'

theotokion.text:
When the Virgin saw her Son being led to the slaughter, she followed him to the Cross and cried: O My sweetest child, what will happen to Thee? Thou knowest that we long to be with Thee,
for we know Thou to be our King and our God!

prokeimenon.refrain: Thy mercy, O Lord, shall pursue me * all the days of my life.
prokeimenon.verse: The Lord is my shepherd, and I shall not want. In a place of green

hymns.text:
Raised upon the Cross, O Christ our God, Thou hast saved mankind.
We glorify Thy sufferings!

Crucified upon the Cross, O Christ our God, Thou hast opened the gates of paradise.
We glorify Thy divinity!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
Thy martyrs, O Lord, forgetting the things of this life, and enduring tortures for the sake of the life to come, were shown to be its inheritors, and now they rejoice with the angels!
By their prayers grant Thy people great mercy!
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them, that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
When she beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O long suffering Lord, Thy Mother mourned and wept. Amazed at Thy surpassing goodness, and Thy compassion and as Thou gavest beyond human nature,
she sang the praises of Thy power!

theotokion.text:
When she beheld Thee nailed upon the Cross, O long suffering Lord, Thy Mother mourned and wept. Amazed at Thy surpassing goodness, and Thy compassion and as Thou gavest beyond human nature,
she sang the praises of Thy power!

dismissalTheotokion.text: O Lamb, the Shepherd and Saviour of the world, Thy Mother saw Thee hanging on the Cross, she cried: Though the world rejoices in its redemption, my being burns as I behold Thy crucifixion,//which Thou endure for all men, my Son and my God!

stichera.text: When I bring to mind the multitude of the evils I have done, and come to consider the dread trial, seized with trembling I flee to Thee, the God Who is the Lover of mankind. Wherefore, disdain me not, I pray Thee, О only Sinless One; grant compunction to my lowly soul before the end, and save me.

Grant me tears as once Thou didst to the sinful woman, О God, and grant that I may wash the feet which have freed me from the path of delusion, and that I may offer Thee a pure life wrought for me by repentance, as myrrh of sweet savor, that even I may hear Thy longed-for voice saying: Thy faith hath saved thee. Go in peace!
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: Ye struggled greatly, О saints, valiantly enduring tortures at the hands of the iniquitous; and though ye have passed from this life, ye still work wonders in this world and heal those made sick by their passions. О holy ones, pray ye that our souls be saved.
