stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: Thy shelter, O Virgin Theotokos, * is spiritual healing; * for, having recourse unto it, ** we are delivered from spiritual infirmities.

hymns.text:
Thou hast enlightened the apostles, O Lord, with the brightness of the comforter. Thou set them as lamps radiant with the light of Thy knowledge, spiritually shining upon the world, O Master.
We worship Thy great goodness!
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
Thou preserve Thy flock unharmed by the temptations of the enemy, surrounding it with the prayers of the apostles as with a wall. O Saviour, Thou hast purchased it with Thy precious blood setting it free from bondage to the stranger
because of Thy compassion.
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
O Blessed apostles, great defenders of the Trinity and intercessors for our souls, thou appear as precious stones of gleaming splendor set in the crown of the Church of Christ,
brightly illumining the world with the light of the knowledge of God.
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: О Lord, Thou hast glorified thine honored and holy hierarch Nicholas to the ends of the earth, imparting to him the grace of miracles; and Thou didst show him to be the champion of those in grievous misfortunes, and those who have fallen into tribulations and afflictions, and who ever ask his help.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: О Lord, have pity on Thy servants through the divine entreaties of Thy holy hierarch, and free us from all misfortune, all affliction, and every attack, for with faith do we bow down before Thine invincible might.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: Having thee as an intercessor and fervent ally before the Master, О Nicholas, we flee to thee with faith, and cry: Turn us not away empty of thy protection, but show that thy loving-kindness extends to thy servants.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: Behold the groaning of my contrite heart, * O Bride of God, * and accept, and reject not, the lifting up of my hands, * O pure and all-immaculate Virgin Mary, * as thou art full of love for mankind; ** that I may hymn and magnify thee who hast exalted our race.

theotokion.text:
Look upon thy servants, O Bride of God. Behold us as we pray and sing to thee. Our hymns are songs of praise to thee,
for thou art the salvation of the human race.

prokeimenon.refrain: O God, in Thy name save me, * and in Thy strength do
prokeimenon.verse: O God, hearken unto my prayer, give ear unto the words of my

hymns.text:
The apostles loved Thee with sincerity on earth! They counted all things as refuse that they might win Thee alone! They surrendered their bodies to torture for Thy sake.
Now in glory, they pray for our souls!

O Lord, Thou hast magnified the memory of the apostles on earth and now in their memory we all glorify Thee, since for their sake Thou grant us healing.
by their prayers granting the world peace and great mercy!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven, Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
Fame and praise befits the saints, for they bowed their necks beneath the sword for Thy sake, who bowed the heavens and came down. They shed their blood for Thee, for Thou emptied Thyself and took the form of a Servant. By emulating Thy poverty they too humbled themselves even unto death. By their prayers have mercy on us, O God,
according to the abundance of Thy great mercies.
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text: Those who were worthy to behold God in the flesh proclaimed thee to be a Bride and a Virgin, O Maiden, worthy of the Father and His divinity. They proclaimed thee to be the Mother of God the Word, and the dwelling of the Holy Spirit, for the whole of divinity, the full and perfect Essence of grace,

theotokion.text: Those who were worthy to behold God in the flesh proclaimed thee to be a Bride and a Virgin, O Maiden, worthy of the Father and His divinity. They proclaimed thee to be the Mother of God the Word, and the dwelling of the Holy Spirit, for the whole of divinity, the full and perfect Essence of grace,

dismissalTheotokion.text: O Pure Theotokos and gate of eternal life: save from danger those who run to thee with faith//to glorify thy holy childbearing for the salvation of our souls!

stichera.text: The staff of Moses prefigured Thy precious Cross, О our Savior; for thereby Thou didst save Thy people from the depths of the sea, О Lover of mankind.

Of old the Garden of Eden put forth in its midst the tree whose fruit was eaten; but Thy Church, О Christ, hath caused the Cross to spring forth, pouring out life upon the world. The one brought death upon Adam, who ate of its fruit, but the other gave life to the thief, who was saved by faith. О Christ God, Who by Thy suffering didst break the snares laid for us by the enemy, show us to share in his salvation, and grant us Thy kingdom, О Lord.
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: О invincible martyrs of Christ, having vanquished error with the power of the Cross, ye received the grace of eternal life; and undaunted by the threats of the tyrants, ye rejoiced as ye were wounded with tortures: and your blood hath now become healing for our souls. Pray ye, that our souls be saved.
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: Beholding Thee hanging upon the Cross, О Lord, the pure one who gave birth to Thee, standing nearby, said, weeping: “O my Child, why dost Thou suffer these things in the flesh and hasten to leave me childless? Hasten Thou, and glorify Thyself, that I may be magnified by Thy suffering!”

hymns.text: To the special melody O Most Strange Wonder
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
O Most strange wonder! The most holy Cross, the life-giving Tree is lifted up on high today and shown to the world. All the ends of the earth give glory; all the devils are frightened. How great a gift is here bestowed on mortals! Through Thy Cross, save our souls, O Christ,
the only compassionate One!
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
O Most strange wonder! The Cross, which carried the Most High as a cluster of grapes full of life is seen today exalted high above the earth. Through the Cross we are all drawn to God and death has been forever swallowed up. Undefiled Wood, through thee we enjoy the immortal fruit of Eden,
as we glorify Christ!
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: О the ineffable goodness of Him * Who became incarnate from thee, О allhymned Theotokos! * For He Who is the Lover of mankind * endured the Cross and death, * that He might save what He created. * Entreat Him, that He may deliver me from torment, * the wretched one who am greatly sick, * and cause me to dwell ** where the never-waning light shines.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: “What is this sight which mine eyes behold, * О Master? * Lifted up upon the Tree, * Thou Who upholdest all creation dost die, * giving life unto all!”, * said the Theotokos, weeping, * when she saw the God and man * who ineffably shone forth from her ** suspended upon the Cross.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: О most pure one, * by thine honored supplications * deliver from misfortunes the flock which thy Son and God * sprinkled with His blood. * And fending off the invisible foe-like wolves, * fill their faces with shame, * as David the psalmist * proclaimed of old, ** О pure one.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: Beholding Thee nailed to the Cross * and voluntarily accepting suffering, O Jesus, * Thy Virgin Mother, O Master, * cried aloud: Woe is me, my sweet Child! * How is it that Thou dost endure * unjustly inflicted wounds, * O Physician Who healeth the infirmities of mankind, * delivering all from corruption ** in Thy tender compassion?

theotokion.text:
O Master, when Thy Mother beheld Thee being nailed to the Cross, she wept and cried out, saying: My sweetest Child, how unjustly Thou suffer! Thou art wounded by lawless men
whom Thou came to save in Thy mercy!

prokeimenon.refrain: My help cometh from the Lord, * Who hath made heaven
prokeimenon.verse: I have lifted up mine eyes to the Mountains, from whence cometh

hymns.text:
Raised upon the Cross, O Christ our God, Thou hast saved mankind.
We glorify Thy sufferings!

Crucified upon the Cross, O Christ our God, Thou hast opened the gates of paradise.
We glorify Thy divinity!
hymns.verse: Unto Thee have I lifted up mine eyes, unto Thee that dwellest in heaven. Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hands of their masters, as the eyes of the handmaid look unto the hands of her Mistress, so do our eyes look unto the Lord our God, * until He take pity on us.

hymns.text:
O Martyrs of the Lord, thou sanctify every place and heal every ill. Now therefore, intercede with Him,
that He may deliver our souls from every wile and snare of the enemy!
hymns.verse: Have mercy on us, О Lord, have mercy on us, for greatly are we filled with abasement. Greatly hath our soul been filled therewith; let reproach come upon them that prosper, * and abasement on the proud.

glory.text:
As she beheld Thee crucified and dying, the Theotokos cried out: Woe is me! How do Thou endure pain, O my sweetest Son? The spear in Thy side pierces my heart, and Thy suffering sets my being on fire. Therefore I sing Thy praises,
for Thou suffer willingly to save mankind!

theotokion.text:
As she beheld Thee crucified and dying, the Theotokos cried out: Woe is me! How do Thou endure pain, O my sweetest Son? The spear in Thy side pierces my heart, and Thy suffering sets my being on fire. Therefore I sing Thy praises,
for Thou suffer willingly to save mankind!

dismissalTheotokion.text: O Lamb, the Shepherd and Saviour of the world, Thy Mother saw Thee hanging on the Cross, she cried: Though the world rejoices in its redemption, my being burns as I behold Thy crucifixion,//which Thou endure for all men, my Son and my God!

stichera.text: Fervently loving Thee on earth, О Lord, Thine apostles considered all to be but dung, that they might acquire Thee alone; and they gave their bodies over to wounds for Thee; wherefore, glorified, they pray for our souls.

О Lord, Thou didst magnify the memory of the apostles on earth, for assembling together thereon, we all glorify Thee; since for their sake Thou hast granted healings, peace and great mercy to the whole world by their prayers.
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: Arrayed well in the breastplate of the Faith, having armed yourselves with the Cross as a sword, ye showed yourselves to be mighty warriors, manfully opposed the tyrants, and cast down the deception of the devil; and, victorious, ye were granted crowns. Pray ye ever on our behalf, that our souls be saved.
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: Rescue me, O lady, * from the hands of the man-slaying serpent, * who wickedly desireth to devour me utterly. * Crush thou his jaws, I pray thee, * and set at naught his wiles, ** that, delivered from his talons, I may magnify thine aid.

hymns.text:
Thy martyrs, O Lord, forgetting the things of this life, and enduring tortures for the sake of the life to come, were shown to be its inheritors, and now they rejoice with the angels!
By their prayers, grant Thy people great mercy!
hymns.verse: If Thou shouldest mark iniquities, О Lord, О Lord, who shall stand? * For with Thee there is forgiveness.

hymns.text:
Fame and praise befits the saints! For they bowed their necks beneath the sword for Thy sake, Who bowed the heavens and came down. They shed blood for Thee, Who emptied Thyself and took the form of a Servant! By emulating Thy poverty, they too humbled themselves even to death. By their prayers, have mercy on us, O God,
according to the abundance of Thy great mercies!
hymns.verse: For Thy name’s sake have I patiently waited for Thee, О Lord; my soul hath waited patiently for Thy word, * my soul hath hoped in the Lord.

hymns.text:
When Thou sit in Thy glory as King of all upon the throne of judgment, with Thy holy angels standing in fear beside Thee, O Christ, and all mankind comes to appear before Thee to be judged: then at the prayers of Thy Mother, O Lord,
deliver from all torment those who have fallen asleep in the faith!
hymns.verse: From the morning watch until night, from the morning watch * let Israel hope in the Lord.

hymns.text: I have become like the barren tree, as if clad with useless leaves; and I am afraid that if I am cut down, Thou wilt send me into unquenchable everlasting fire, О Master. But grant me time to convert, that I may offer Thee the goodly fruit of virtuous acts, and may be deemed worthy of Thy kingdom.
hymns.verse: For with the Lord there is mercy, and with Him there is plenteous redemption; * and He shall redeem Israel out of all his iniquities.

hymns.text: O Lord, О Lord, Who lovest mankind, turn not Thy face away from me, Thy servant, who angereth Thy goodness every day, neither punish me by Thy righteous wrath, О Christ. I confess that I have sinned, I have sinned against Thee like none other. But have pity and save me, by the prayers of Thy Mother.
hymns.verse: О praise the Lord, all ye nations; * praise Him, all ye peoples.

hymns.text: When in Thy glory Thou shalt sit as the King of all upon Thy judgment-seat, and all the holy angels stand before Thee with fear, and all human nature will stand before Thee to be judged, О Christ; then, through the supplications of Thy Mother, О Lord, from all torments deliver those who have fallen asleep in faith.
hymns.verse: For He hath made His mercy to prevail over us, * and the truth of the Lord abideth forever.

glory.text: In His love for mankind, the King of heaven appeared on earth * and dwelt among men; * for He Who received flesh from the pure Virgin * and cameth forth from her having received human nature, * is the only Son of God, * twofold in nature but not Hypostasis. * Therefore, proclaiming Him to be truly perfect God and perfect man, * we confess Christ our God. * Him do thou beseech, O unwedded Mother, ** that our souls find mercy!

theotokion.text: The King of heaven, because of His love for mankind, appeared on earth and dwelt with men. He took flesh from the pure Virgin and after assuming it, He came forth from her. The Son is one: two natures, yet one Person. Proclaiming

prokeimenon.refrain: O God, my helper art Thou, * and Thy mercy shall go
prokeimenon.verse: Rescue me from mine enemies, O God, and from them that rise up

hymns.text:
Entreat our God, O martyrs of the Lord, and beseech great bounties for our souls,
and purification of our many transgressions!

In tears and sorrow I contemplate death; I see our beauty, created in God's image, laid in the grave without form, or honor, or comeliness. Great mystery and fearful end awaiting us! How have we been handed over to corruption? How has death been wedded to us? Truly, as it is written, it is by the commandment of God,
Who grants rest to the departed!
hymns.verse: Blessed are they whom Thou hast chosen * and taken to Thyself, О Lord.

hymns.text:
Thy death, O Lord, has been the means of immortality, for if Thou had not been placed in the grave, Paradise would not have been opened.
Therefore give rest to the departed as the Lover of mankind!
hymns.verse: Their souls * shall dwell among good things.

glory.text:
O Pure Virgin, the gate of the word, and Mother of our God:
Pray that we may be saved!

theotokion.text:
O Pure Virgin, the gate of the word, and Mother of our God:
Pray that we may be saved!

stichera.text: The staff of Moses prefigured Thy precious Cross, О our Savior; for thereby Thou hast save Thy people from the depths of the sea, О Lover of mankind.

Of old the Garden of Eden put forth in its midst the tree whose fruit was eaten; but Thy Church, О Christ, hath caused the Cross to spring forth, pouring out life upon the world. The one brought death upon Adam, who ate of its fruit, but the other gave life to the thief who was saved by faith. О Christ God, Who by Thy suffering didst break the snares laid for us by the enemy, show us to share in his salvation, and grant us Thy kingdom, О Lord.
stichera.verse: We were filled in the morning with Thy mercy, О Lord, and we rejoiced and were glad. In all our days, let us be glad for the days wherein Thou didst humble us, for the years wherein we saw evils. And look upon Thy servants, and upon Thy works, * and do Thou guide their sons.

stichera.text: What shall we call you, О saints? Cherubim, for Christ rested on you. Seraphim, for ye glorified Him without ceasing. Angels, for ye rejected your bodies. Powers, for ye work miracles. Many are your names, and great your gifts. Pray ye that our souls be saved.
stichera.verse: And let the brightness of the Lord our God be upon us, and the works of our hands do Thou guide aright upon us, * yea, the work of our hands do Thou guide aright.

glory.text: “I cannot bear to see Thee asleep upon the Tree, Who givest wakefulness to all, that Thou mightest give divine and saving watchfulness to those who have fallen into most pernicious sleep through the fruit of disobedience!”, the Virgin, whom we magnify, said, weeping.
